home_definition: verified folded physical home; every actuator reports raw 2048
calibration_status: provisional upstream envelope; ID1-ID6 directions verified, all operating ranges (minimum/maximum raw, gains, torque limits) still require right-arm measurement
positive_direction_definition: positive joint direction; ID1 raw increase is clockwise viewed from above, ID2 raw increase moves the arm forward, ID3 raw increase moves the forearm/wrist end downward, ID4 raw increase flexes the wrist downward, ID5 raw increase is counterclockwise viewed from the elbow side toward the gripper, ID6 raw increase opens the gripper

joints.name: WRIST_FLEX
joints.raw_increase_observation: wrist flexes downward (observed as raw decrease moving the wrist up)

joints.name: WRIST_ROLL
joints.raw_increase_observation: counterclockwise viewed from the elbow side toward the gripper

joints.name: GRIPPER
joints.raw_increase_observation: gripper opens (observed as raw decrease closing the moving jaw)
